blinding_guess.why: All nine packet parameters are declared in the UsbCamNode constructor with defaults whose types match the bundled YAML files; the only oddity is that framerate is declared as double (30.0) but stored in an int field of parameters_t (usb_cam.hpp:84), truncating fractional rates, which does not change the declared interface.

notes: All packet elements are ROS 2 node parameters declared via this->declare_parameter in src/usb_cam_node.cpp:62-70; types are inferred from the default values (string literal -> string, 30.0 -> double, integer literal -> int). They are read back through a SyncParametersClient (get_params, lines 185-198) and assign_params (lines 200-249), where framerate uses as_double(), image_height/image_width use as_int(), and the others use value_to_string(). Parameters carry no message type, QoS, rate or definition hash, so those fields are null. frame is recorded as 'none' for every parameter because none of them is spatial data; the frame_id parameter's value (default "default_cam", "camera" in config/params_1.yaml:6) is the frame name the node writes into the image and camera_info headers (src/usb_cam_node.cpp:135,141). Units: framerate is logged as FPS (line 143) and turned into a timer period of 1000.0/framerate ms (line 178); image_width/image_height feed m_image.width/height (src/usb_cam.cpp:519-520), whose product is number_of_pixels (usb_cam.hpp:112). exclusive is empty: the video device is opened with O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK (src/usb_cam.cpp:503) with no O_EXCL or lock. ros_distro is null in the packet; no dependency definition files were needed. Other parameters declared by the node (brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, gain, auto_white_balance, white_balance, autoexposure, exposure, autofocus, focus) are not packet elements and are not recorded.
